But the night was as troublesome to him as the day; wherefore, instead of sleeping, he spent it in sighs and tears.

arxiv-2102-00405.title: BNLP: Natural language processing toolkit for Bengali
arxiv-2102-00405.creator: Sagor Sarker
arxiv-2102-00405.description: Abstract BNLP is an open-source language processing toolkit for Bengali consisting of tokenization, word embedding, part of speech(POS) tagging, name entity recognition(NER) facilities. BNLP provides pre-trained model with high accuracy to do model-based tokenization, embedding, POS, NER tasks for Bengali. BNLP pre-trained model achieves significant results in Bengali text tokenization, word embeddings, POS, and NER task.

arxiv-2112-10649.title: Local properties of the t t - J J model in a two-pole approximation within COM Journal: Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials
arxiv-2112-10649.creator: Amir Eskandari-asl 1, Adolfo Avella 1,2,3
arxiv-2112-10649.description: Abstract In this work, we study the t t - J J model using a two-pole approximation within the composite operator method. We choose a basis of two composite operators – the constrained electrons and their spin-fluctuation dressing – and approximate their currents in order to compute the corresponding Green’s functions.

arxiv-2206-02930.title: Predicting Electricity Infrastructure Induced Wildfire Risk in California
arxiv-2206-02930.creator: Mengqi Yao Duncan S. Callaway, Mengqi Yao 1 , Meghana Bharadwaj 2 , Zheng Zhang 3 , Baihong Jin 2 and Duncan S. Callaway 1
arxiv-2206-02930.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mengqi Yao Duncan S. Callaway, Mengqi Yao 1 , Meghana Bharadwaj 2 , Zheng Zhang 3 , Baihong Jin 2 and Duncan S. Callaway 1. This paper examines the use of risk models to predict the timing and location of wildfires caused by electricity infrastructure.

arxiv-2208-09919.title: Large and Moderate deviation for multivalued McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation
arxiv-2208-09919.creator: Wei Liu, Fengwu Zhu
arxiv-2208-09919.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, we present sufficient conditions and criteria to establish the large and moderate deviation principle for multivalued McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation by means of the weak convergence method. Key words Multivalued McKean-Vlasov SDE, Large deviation, Moderate deviation, Weak convergence method.

arxiv-2211-05492.title: T T -linear resistivity, optical conductivity and Planckian transport for a holographic local quantum critical metal in a periodic potential
arxiv-2211-05492.creator: F. Balm, N. Chagnet ∗ , S. Arend, J. Aretz, K. Grosvenor, M. Janse, O. Moors, J. Post , V. Ohanesjan, D. Rodriguez-Fernandez, K. Schalm and J. Zaanen
arxiv-2211-05492.description: Abstract High T c T_{c} cuprate strange metals are characterized by a DC-resistivity that scales linearly with T T from the onset of superconductivity to the crystal melting temperature, characterized by a current life time τ ℏ ≃ ℏ / ( k B ​ T ) \tau_{\hbar}\simeq\hbar/(k_{B}T) , the “Planckian dissipation”.

arxiv-2211-09777.title: Engineering and probing non-Abelian chiral spin liquids using periodically driven ultracold atoms
arxiv-2211-09777.creator: Bo-Ye Sun, Nathan Goldman, Monika Aidelsburger, Marin Bukov
arxiv-2211-09777.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bo-Ye Sun, Nathan Goldman, Monika Aidelsburger, Marin Bukov. We propose a scheme to implement Kitaev’s honeycomb model with cold atoms, based on a periodic (Floquet) drive, in view of realizing and probing non-Abelian chiral spin liquids using quantum simulators. We derive the effective Hamiltonian to leading order in the inverse-frequency expansion, and show that the drive opens up a topological gap in the spectrum without mixing the effective Majorana and vortex degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2304-08904.title: Smallworldness in Hypergraphs
arxiv-2304-08904.creator: Tanu Raghav 1 , Stefano Boccaletti 1,2,3,4 , Sarika Jalan 1
arxiv-2304-08904.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tanu Raghav 1 , Stefano Boccaletti 1,2,3,4 , Sarika Jalan 1. Most real-world networks are endowed with the small-world property, by means of which the maximal distance between any two of their nodes scales logarithmically rather than linearly with their size. The evidence sparkled a wealth of studies trying to reveal possible mechanisms through which the pairwise interactions amongst the units of a network are structured in a way to determine such observed regularity.

arxiv-2304-11256.title: UBC-DLNLP at SemEval-2023 Task 12: Impact of Transfer Learning on African Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2304-11256.creator: Gagan Bhatia Ife Adebara AbdelRahim Elmadany Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
arxiv-2304-11256.description: Abstract We describe our contribution to the SemEVAl 2023 AfriSenti-SemEval shared task, where we tackle the task of sentiment analysis in 14 14 different African languages. We develop both monolingual and multilingual models under a full supervised setting (subtasks A and B). We also develop models for the zero-shot setting (subtask C).

arxiv-2311-09541.title: Cauchy-Riemann beams in GRIN media
arxiv-2311-09541.creator: I. Ramos-Prieto, D. Sánchez-de-la-Llave, U. Ruíz, V. Arrizón, F. Soto-Eguibar, H. M. Moya-Cessa
arxiv-2311-09541.description: Abstract We investigate the propagation characteristics of Cauchy-Riemann beams in gradient-index media. Our study reveals two key findings: a) the preservation of their form during propagation, and b) surprisingly, the feasibility of obtaining the fractional Fourier transform for any arbitrary entire function. We provide an explicit and straightforward expression for this transform.

arxiv-2502-16486.title: MQADet: A Plug-and-Play Paradigm for Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Object Detection via Multimodal Question Answering
arxiv-2502-16486.creator: Caixiong Li, Xiongwei Zhao, Jinhang Zhang, Xing Zhang, Qihao Sun, Zhou Wu
arxiv-2502-16486.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) is a challenging task to detect and classify objects from an unrestricted set of categories, including those unseen during training. Existing open-vocabulary detectors are limited by complex visual-textual misalignment and long-tailed category imbalances, leading to suboptimal performance in challenging scenarios.

arxiv-2503-09069.title: Theoretical Guarantees for High Order Trajectory Refinement in Generative Flows
arxiv-2503-09069.creator: Chengyue Gong, Xiaoyu Li, Yingyu Liang, Jiangxuan Long, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Yu Tian
arxiv-2503-09069.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chengyue Gong, Xiaoyu Li, Yingyu Liang, Jiangxuan Long, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Yu Tian. Flow matching has emerged as a powerful framework for generative modeling, offering computational advantages over diffusion models by leveraging deterministic Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) instead of stochastic dynamics. While prior work established the worst case optimality of standard flow matching under Wasserstein distances, the theoretical guarantees for higher-order flow matching - which incorporates acceleration terms to refine sample trajectories - remain unexplored.

arxiv-2504-05945.title: CKGAN: Training Generative Adversarial Networks Using Characteristic Kernel Integral Probability Metrics
arxiv-2504-05945.creator: 1 Kuntian Zhang, 2 Simin Yu, 2,3 Yaoshu Wang
arxiv-2504-05945.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose CKGAN, a novel generative adversarial network (GAN) variant based on an integral probability metrics framework with characteristic kernel (CKIPM). CKIPM, as a distance between two probability distributions, is designed to optimize the lowerbound of the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, and thus can be used to train GANs.

arxiv-2505-06358.title: TESS Investigation - Demographics of Young Exoplanets (TI-DYE) III: an inner super-Earth in TOI-2076 Facilities: TESS
arxiv-2505-06358.creator: Madyson G. Barber, Andrew W. Mann, Andrew Vanderburg, Andrew W. Boyle, Ana Isabel Lopez Murillo
arxiv-2505-06358.description: Abstract Young ( < < 500 Myr) multi-planet transiting systems are valuable environments for understanding planet evolution by offering an opportunity to make direct comparisons between planets from the same formation conditions. TOI-2076 is known to harbor three, 2.5-4 R ⊕ planets on 10-35 day orbits. All three are JWST cycle 3 targets (for transmission spectroscopy).

arxiv-2507-12300.title: Sturm–Liouville operators with periodically modulated parameters. Part I: Regular case
arxiv-2507-12300.creator: Grzegorz Świderski, Bartosz Trojan
arxiv-2507-12300.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Grzegorz Świderski, Bartosz Trojan. We introduce a new class of Sturm–Liouville operators with periodically modulated parameters. Their spectral properties depend on the monodromy matrix of the underlying periodic problem computed for the spectral parameter equal to 0 0 . Under certain assumptions, by studying the asymptotic behavior of Christoffel functions and density of states, we prove that the spectral density is a continuous positive everywhere function on the real line. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2602-18911.title: From Human-Level AI Tales to AI Leveling Human Scales
arxiv-2602-18911.creator: Peter Romero, Fernando Martínez-Plumed, Zachary R. Tyler, Matthieu Téhénan, Sipeng Chen, Álvaro David Gómez Antón, Luning Sun, Manuel Cebrian, Lexin Zhou, Yael Moros Daval, Daniel Romero-Alvarado, Félix Martí Pérez, Kevin Wei, José Hernández-Orallo
arxiv-2602-18911.description: Abstract Comparing AI models to “human level” is often misleading when benchmark scores are incommensurate or human baselines are drawn from a narrow population. To address this, we propose a framework that calibrates items against the ‘world population’ and report performance on a common, human-anchored scale.

pmc-10609069.title: Unveiling Various Facades of Tinospora cordifolia Stem in Food: Medicinal and Nutraceutical Aspects
pmc-10609069.creator: Varisha Anjum, Uday Bagale, Ammar Kadi, Irina Potoroko, Shirish H Sonawane, Areefa Anjum, Ladislav Kokoska
pmc-10609069.description: Natural products with curative properties are gaining immense popularity in scientific and food research, possessing no side effects in contrast to other drugs. Guduchi, or Tinospora cordifolia, belongs to the menispermaceae family of universal drugs used to treat various diseases in traditional Indian literature.

pmc-12508421.title: Advances in biomarkers of resistance to KRAS mutation-targeted inhibitors
pmc-12508421.creator: Lihao Wang, Dandan Wei, Shanshan Li, Shiqing Jiang
pmc-12508421.description: KRAS mutations represent the most common driver genetic alterations in multiple malignant tumors, particularly exerting well-defined oncogenic driver roles in non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The recent success of KRAS G12C mutation-specific allosteric inhibitors marks a therapeutic milestone in KRAS-targeted oncology.

pmc-12577391.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward mpox among university health science students in Türkiye: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12577391.creator: Ömer Ataç, Ayşe Nur Balcı Yapalak, Osman Hayran
pmc-12577391.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study was to examine the level of knowledge, attitudes and preventive practices regarding mpox among health science students.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted among a group of students from four schools of a university in İstanbul, Türkiye. All students were invited to participate voluntarily, and the final sample represented convenience sampling based on classroom attendance.

pmc-12704298.title: Divergent acetyl-CoA binding modes mediate allosteric inhibition of bacterial hybrid-type malic enzymes
pmc-12704298.creator: Munetoshi Sassa, Haruka Yamato, Hiroki Tanino, Yohta Fukuda, Tsuyoshi Inoue
pmc-12704298.description: Malic enzymes (MEs) function as the bypass enzyme in the Krebs cycle and have attracted attention in a wide range of scientific and industrial fields. In contrast to eukaryotic MEs, there is currently a lack of understanding of the structure-function relationships of prokaryotic MEs.

pmc-13201541.title: Stampede detection and crowd analysis using CNN-LSTM and farneback optical flow
pmc-13201541.creator: Geetanjali Bhola, Sumit Srivastava, Hith Rahil Nidhan, Sanyam Kathed
pmc-13201541.description: Stampede incidents in densely populated environments remain a critical challenge for public safety, resulting in severe casualties and significant disruption. This paper presents a novel, data-driven framework for automated stampede detection and crowd risk classification, leveraging the integration of Farneback optical-flow computation with a hybrid CNN-LSTM architecture.
